description: The departments of the whole network (electronics, home, toys, fashion, …) with the categories of their sites in the locale's language: key, name, parent, number of products and the sites that have it. Use browse_category for a category's products.

locale.description: Language and market (nl-NL = Dutch for the Netherlands, fr-BE = French for Belgium, de-DE = German for Germany, en-NL = English for the Netherlands; FR, DK and SE too). Shops, prices, currency and stock are per market; only sites that serve the locale answer. Default nl-NL.

name: list_departments
title: Departments and their categories
